summary: Okanogan NF summit: a 1930s crow's nest with a tent cabin, listed abandoned. No source says what remains or whether it is open.

facts.design: Crow's nest with a tent cabin
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned; no source says whether anything remains on the summit.

corrections.why: Both lists say abandoned. No source says the structure is gone, and the Willhite page hopes a tree may still be standing.
The Forest Fire Lookout Association list types this site as Crowsnest, and firelookout.com describes a crow's nest with a tent cabin.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only date is 1930s, from firelookout.com and from the Kresek inventory as quoted by Willhite; the Kresek inventory itself was not read. No abandonment date. Location is the FFLA point, but Willhite doubts the lookout stood on this summit and says the mountain has several high points, so the point may mark the mountain rather than the lookout. Willhite's page is undated and says a visit is still to come; nobody has confirmed what remains. The Forest Service and state pages were not checked. Corrections: status gone to abandoned (no source says removed) and kind platform to crowsnest.
